models.name: shopping_mall_channels
models.description: Represents different shopping channels within the e-commerce platform. Channels can be used to organize different shopping experiences such as main store, outlet section, seasonal promotions, or specialized marketplaces. Each channel has its own configuration and section organization. Channels serve as the top-level organizational structure for the shopping experience.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique channel identifier code used for system references and URL routing. Must be URL-safe and unique across the platform.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Display name of the channel shown to users and administrators. Used for navigation and display purposes.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description explaining the channel's purpose, target audience, and business context.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current operational status of the channel: active (available to users), inactive (hidden but maintained), or maintenance (temporarily unavailable).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the channel was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the channel was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the channel was soft deleted, if applicable. Allows for recovery of accidentally deleted channels.

models.name: shopping_mall_sections
models.description: Organizes content within shopping channels. Sections represent logical groupings of products or content within a channel, such as featured products, new arrivals, or category-based sections. Sections enable hierarchical organization and targeted content presentation.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Parent channel that contains this section. Each section belongs to exactly one channel. {@link shopping_mall_channels.id}

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique section identifier code within the parent channel. Used for system references and URL routing. Must be unique within each channel.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Display name of the section shown to users. Used for navigation and display within the channel.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the section's content, purpose, and target audience.

plainFields.name: section_type
plainFields.description: Type of section: featured (highlighted content), category (product category based), promotional (sales and offers), or custom (user-defined organization).

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Numerical order for section display sequence within the channel. Lower numbers appear first. Used to control section presentation order.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the section: active (visible to users), inactive (hidden but maintained), or hidden (completely removed from display).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the section was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: shopping_mall_configurations
models.description: Stores system-wide configuration settings and platform parameters. These configurations control platform behavior, feature toggles, and operational parameters. Configurations are managed by administrators and affect global platform functionality.

plainFields.name: config_key
plainFields.description: Unique configuration key used to reference the setting in code. Follows dot notation for hierarchical organization (e.g., 'payment.stripe.api_key').

plainFields.name: config_value
plainFields.description: Configuration value stored as string, to be parsed based on context. Supports various data types through proper parsing logic.

plainFields.name: data_type
plainFields.description: Data type of the configuration value: string, number, boolean, json, array, or object. Guides proper value parsing and validation.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable description of what this configuration controls, its purpose, and any constraints or dependencies.

plainFields.name: category
plainFields.description: Category grouping for related configurations: payment, shipping, ui, security, notifications, analytics, etc.

plainFields.name: is_sensitive
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this configuration contains sensitive data that requires encryption and access control protection.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the configuration was soft deleted, if applicable.
